subject: ggplot facet wrap y axis scale - control of olower bound only

messages.author: 49a3118c00a11313
messages.subject: ggplot facet wrap y axis scale - control of olower bound only
parts:
Hello

 

I am doing a facet plot and I want control of y axis lower bound only (I want to set it to zero). I want upper bound y axis to maintain its variability across the facets.

This is to remove content below the y axis, which I don’t want to display.

 

I have searched for work arounds [coord_cartesian(), geom_blank()] and can’t find one using ggplot functions.

Is there another ggplot function that would do what I need?

 

What I would like is a coord_cartesian() function that allows each limit be specified alone – i.e.:

 

CURRENT: coord_cartesian(xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL, expand = TRUE)

 

SUGGESTED: coord_cartesian(xlimLower = NULL, xlimUpper = NULL, ylimLower = NULL, ylimUpper = NULL, expand = TRUE)



many thanks,

Jeremy
